description: The Public Service Commission - Delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission to the Public Officers in terms of Article 57(1) of the Constitution and to the Education Service Committee in terms of Article 56(1) of the Constitution relating to the subject of Education
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the delegation of powers by the Public Service Commission for disciplinary control, transfers, appointments, and promotions of public officers in the education sector. It deals specifically with public service administration, recruitment, and disciplinary matters, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
